name: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Orange County, CA?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Orange County, CA?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen remodel in Orange County, CA, can range widely based on materials, finishes, appliances, and labor. A basic remodel might start from $25,000 to $45,000, while a mid-range renovation often falls between $45,000 and $80,000. High-end custom kitchens with premium materials and custom cabinetry can exceed $100,000. These figures include demolition, new cabinetry, countertops, flooring, plumbing, and electrical work. We provide detailed estimates tailored to your specific design choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen remodels in Orange County, CA, typically range from $25,000 for basic to over $100,000 for high-end projects.
